dedupe_keys.name: les passages a niveau du reseau ferre du nord ouest

description: Les passages à niveau du réseau ferré du Nord-OUEST is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Société Nationale Des Chemins de Fer Tunisiens SNCFT. Ce jeu de données décrit les passages à niveau du réseau ferré de la SNCFT pour la zone du Nord Ouest la Tunisie, les coordonnées géographiques, l'état du passage et la date d'acquisition. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Société Nationale Des Chemins de Fer Tunisiens SNCFT. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
